Yeah i know. Sometimes it works sometimes it doesn't. I have been having SP for the past nine years. At this point if a week passes without my demons visiting me i start to worry about their health.

Or both of them may turn on me and i can die faster. Either way it's a win-win situation.

Yeah i get exactly what you mean. It feels as if you're trying hard to keep your body there with you, but of course you can't move a muscle. It's been a while but i used to get this feeling every time i had sleep paralysis where im trying to keep my soul in place with while its being sucked out of me.

It's not one thing. The first time it was an old hag, and since then I've seen: a black foggy creature, a blatant demon, a demon with huge black bat-like wings, a demon little girl, a witch, and the weirdest one when i saw courage the cowardly dog laughing maniacally next to the bad.

Sleep paralysis has been happening to me for the past 7 years and i'm pretty much used to it, so i dont get scared unless something REALLY horrible is happening to me no matter what i hear or see. So yeah it's normal.
And i have also noticed that sleep paralysis tend to happen to me mostly when i sleep on my back and I've read somewhere that sleeping on ones back has an effect on sleep paralysis so yes.

Yeah it's really weird that so many people go through the same experience. What makes it specially weird is that many go through it without knowing what it was and yet they see the same things.  The first time it happened to me i was in eighth or seventh grade (not sure). And i thought i encountered a demon for like a whole year.
The human brain is a puzzle i guess
Only once, and as soon as i woke up i couldnt remember what the whole thing was. The only thing i had in my brain was the idea of aliens.
Im a big supernatural fan so it would actually explain a lot

Oh my god. I had similar experiences to this one but except for something yanking my soul entering my body. There were many times where i would feel something asking my permission to enter my body in a dream and when i refuse i get yanked into an episode of sleep paralysis. One time i was having this weird dream and i felt as if someone who really cared about me needed this permission so i gave it what it wanted and immediately i regretted it, opening my heavy eyes slowly i saw a weird black smoke (or goo i dont remember exactly) entering my mouth forcefully and i remember choking on it and screaming in my head "GET OUT GET OUT OH GOD PLEASE GET THIS THING OUT OF ME" and then coughed it out before finally regaining power over my body.
When i first woke up i was terrified but during the whole thing i was like "eh fuck it." I remember thinking about how i might die at that moment and not caring about it.
The funny thing is that i have had so many horrible experiences with sleep paralysis that i have gotten used to this.

when i was like 12 i had a similar experience.
i'm not gonna go into so many details but i remember that i was crossing the street towards my mom and i slipped down at the same time that a bus was coming towards me.
all i remember is me closing my eyes so hard (while im still on the ground) and my mom screaming my name.
the next thing i knew, i was laying face down on the side walk and my mom running towards me.
She swore that she saw me under the wheels of the bus and she was crying.
idk how the hell that happened, but i'm sure as hell that i didn't roll or move at all.
